FIXED AMOUNT OF EXCISE DUTY (PVC WIRES AND CABLES) RULES, 1996
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part 11, 13th June, 1996]
S.R.O. 464(1)/96 dated 13‑6‑1996.‑‑‑In
exercise of the powers conferred by subsections (8) and (9) of section 3 of the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944) read with section 37 thereof, the Central
Board of Revenue, with the prior approval of the Federal Government, is pleased
to make the following rules for the levy and collection of fixed amount of duty
on the basis of extruders used for the manufacture of PVC wires and cables, in
lieu of the duty of excise leviable on wires and cables under subsection (1) of
the said section, namely:‑‑‑
1. Short title, commencement and application.‑‑(1)
These rules may be called the Fixed Amount of Excise Duty (PVC Wires and
Cables) Rules, 1996.
(2) They shall, unless
rescinded earlier, remain in force during the financial year 1996‑97.
(3) They shall apply to such
manufacturer who manufacture only PVC wires and cables having cross‑sectional
area not more than 8 mm2 used for domestic purposes with the help of
domestically fabricated extruders and does not employ more than eight labourers
including himself and his dependents in the factory, and elects for application
of these rules as provided in rule 3:
Provided that they shall not
apply to manufacturers whose annual turnover, of all goods, including wires and
cables, produced in his establishment exceeds one million rupees during the
financial year 1995‑96.
2. Interpretation.‑‑‑In these rules,
unless there is anything repugnant in the subject or context, the words and
expressions used but not defined herein shall have the same meaning as in the
Central Excises Act, 1944 (I of 1944), and the rules made thereunder.
3. Declaration to be made.‑‑‑The
manufacturer who elects to pay duty under these rules for the year 1996‑97
shall apply to that effect in writing to the Superintendent of jurisdiction
within fifteen days from the date of this Notification, declaring the number of
extruders installed. in his factory, annual turnover (in rupees) of all goods
including PVC wires and cables produced or manufactured by the establishment
and shall pay excise duty at the rate of seven thousand five hundred rupees per
extruder per month on all the extruders installed in the factory irrespective
of whether or not any extruder is operational or is not in working condition.
4. Option to be irrevocable. ‑‑‑The
option exercised under rule 3 shall be irrevocable for the financial year 1996‑97.
5. Amount of
duty‑ and date of payment.‑‑(1) The amount of duty shall
be paid by the manufacturer by the 25th day of each month preceding the month
to which it relates and duty for July and August, 1996, shall be paid before
the 25th July, 1996.
(2) If the duty is not paid by
the due date, the manufacturer shall, without prejudice to any other penal
action which may be taken under the Central Excises Act, 1944, or the rules
framed thereunder be liable to pay additional duty in terms of section 3B of
the said Act.
6. Removal and addition.‑‑(1)
A manufacturer may replace an extruder installed in the factory after giving at
least ten days' advance notice to the concerned Superintendent and the extruder
(to be replaced) installed in the factory shall be dismantled before any action
is taken to install a new extruder.
(2) If during the course of the
financial year, the manufacturer installs an additional extruder in his
factory, he shall pay duty thereon from the beginning of the month in which the
additional extruder is installed.
(3) For installing, any
additional extruder, the manufacturer shall give at least ten days advance
notice to the Superintendent Central Excise.
7. Waiver not allowed.‑‑(1)
No waiver of duty shall be admissible if any extruder is removed from the factory
or if the factory is closed for any reason whatsoever.
(2) No waiver, rebate or
remission of Excise duty shall be allowed on any account whatsoever, including
